description: Start a video generation job (text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last frame, references). Spends credits: tell the user the cost from list_models first. Returns a job id immediately; the video takes from about 30 s to several minutes, so follow up with get_job.

aspect_ratio.description: One of the model's aspect_ratios, e.g. "16:9"

duration.description: Seconds as a string, one of the model's durations, e.g. "8"

idempotency_key.description: Recommended: pass your own unique key (e.g. a UUID) and keep it. Retrying with the same key never charges twice, even if the first response was lost. Generated when omitted and returned in the result.

image_url.description: Image-to-video source image (public URL, or the url from upload_media)

last_frame_url.description: Requires first_frame_url; not every model supports it

multi_prompt.description: Kling multi-shot prompts, as documented at https://api.aiveed.io/llms-full.txt

resolution.description: One of the model's resolutions, e.g. "720p"

sound.description: Kling: false for a silent video

name: generate_video
title: Generate video
